reference_action: Give a good soak and trim dead/yellow leaves; OP explicitly reports improvement after soak and trim. Repotting appears in the summary but is not the stated recovery action.

sources.reason: “A little water at a time” does not give the thorough soak and trim OP validated, and attributes damage to burn rather than dehydration.
TikTok caption has no self-contained care advice and no accessible video transcript was captured.

Removing all soil, peroxide soak and a month of water culture is not the same immediate soil-plant rehydration and trim.

actions.action: Give a little water at a time

resolved.reason: The burn diagnosis is wrong and the limited watering instruction overlaps hydration but does not specify the successful soak or trim.

harmfulness.reason: “Just a bit burnt” misidentifies the problem, and “a little water at a time” may under-deliver water to a severely dehydrated root ball. It does at least direct watering, so likely worsening is not established, but the missing quantity/saturation safeguard is material.

specificity_accuracy.reason: “Burnt” does not match the confirmed dehydration and healthy roots. Watering overlaps one useful action, but neither a good soak nor trimming damaged leaves is described.

feasibility.reason: The instruction needs only ordinary water. However, “a little” and “at a time” leave both amount and frequency undefined.
